title: Ushinawareta Mirai wo Motomete: Ushinawareta Natsuyasumi wo Motomete
justification: AniList 21405 (SPECIAL, 1 episode, summer 2015) is AniDB 10372's special S1 "In Search of the Lost Summer Vacation", aired 2015-08-29. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 20591, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 10372, and the special's title matches the AniList titles (romaji and native). AniList gives the year and season only, so the start-date check cannot apply; the title and the 1-episode count agree. TVDB 284211 places the special at S0E1 "In Search of the Lost Summer Vacation", 2015-08-29, the same date; the node has no mapping list, so S1 lands on S0E1 by default.
